fact: On 10 February 2026 the Justice Minister launched digital issuance of criminal-record and nationality certificates and said eight jurisdictions were already interconnected in the pilot of the integrated judicial case-file system, with two more to follow.
title: SEMAINE NATIONALE DE LA JUSTICE : LA DÉLIVRANCE DIGITALE DU CASIER JUDICIAIRE ET DU CERTIFICAT DE NATIONALITÉ LANCÉE HIER
